objective: Assess the setup TUI commit's first-use package install and cache loading for security vulnerabilities.
scope: Worktree /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-tui, commit df6a410; diff: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad/tui-review.diff. Focus: packages/runtime/src/setup/tui/ (install into a per-user cache with the Bun Shell, then import a bundle from there), bundle.ts and the generate.ts changes.

Trace sources to sinks: the cache path (environment variables XDG_CACHE_HOME, HOME, LOCALAPPDATA), the version strings embedded at build time, the Bun Shell command that installs, the registry used, lockfile or integrity checking, what is imported and from where, a cache another local user or process could write to, a half-written install, symlinks in the cache, and whether a project's own bunfig.toml or .npmrc in the current directory can redirect the install.
constraints: Substantiate each finding with path:line and a realistic attack path; rate severity.

criteria.text: Each finding has path:line, an attack path and a severity
The review states whether the install and import can be redirected or tampered with
